items.title: 14.7 Greenhouse effect aur global warming (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.7 with Figure 14.5, printed pages 313-314.

blocks.title: Global warming aur greenhouse effect
blocks.text: Global warming insani sargarmiyon, bunyadi taur par fossil fuels jalane se nikli greenhouse gases (GHGs) ke ikhraj, ki wajah se zameen ke ausat satahi darja hararat mein lambi muddat ka izafa hai. Fiza mein greenhouse gases ke kambal jaise asar se zameen ki satah ka batadreej garam hona greenhouse effect hai (Figure 14.5).

Yeh hawa ki aaloodgi ka aalmi paimane ka masla hai. Fiza mein carbon dioxide aur pani ke bukharat chhoti wavelength ki sooraji shuaein guzarne dete hain magar zameen ki garam satah se aane wali lambi wavelength ki garmi ki shuaein wapas mor dete hain. Greenhouse effect in gases ki infrared shuaein jazb karne ki salahiyat par mabni hai: din mein sooraj ki garmi fiza se guzar kar zameen garam karti hai; raat ko zameen garmi khala ki taraf nikalti hai, aur kuch fizai gases woh garmi rok kar us ka nuqsan rokti hain. Carbon dioxide aur doosri gases ki concentration jitni zyada, thermal shuaon ka jazb hona utna zyada aur aalmi darja hararat mein izafa utna zyada.

blocks.prompt: Greenhouse gases ke naam batayein aur wazeh karein ke yeh global warming kaise karti hain (Quick Check 14.3b; exercise Q.4ii).
blocks.explanation: Carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, pani ke bukharat aur CFCs. Yeh zameen garam karne wali chhoti-mauj dhoop ke liye shaffaf hain magar zameen se nikalne wali lambi-mauj infrared jazb kar ke us ka hissa wapas neeche bhejti hain; in gases jitni zyada, utni zyada garmi satah ke qareeb rukti hai, greenhouse ke sheeshe ki tarah, aur ausat darja hararat barhta hai.

items: Greenhouse effect: CO2, H2O bukharat aur doosri GHGs chhoti-mauj dhoop andar aane deti hain magar zameen ki lambi-mauj infrared jazb karti hain; fossil fuels se barhti GHG concentrations aalmi darja hararat barhati hain: global warming, aalmi paimane ka aaloodgi ka masla.
